systemicObservation: Sixth consecutive candidate with no blocker, and the cleanest measurement set in the chain: every governing source is pinned at its live value, the re-measurement is taken at the adopted head, and the substantive contract - selector, G16 classes, identity dependencies - is byte-identical to its predecessor. The one surviving finding is the narrowest yet and is a new species of the succession-record defect this chain has produced four times before. At v3 the record was empty when it should have been full; at v5 an array was empty when the frozen bytes held one entry; at v10 a list was edited by substitution so its size hid the loss. Here the record names a frozen finding id and marks it repaired, and the entry is true - of a different finding that happens to share the id suffix. CLAUDE-V10-A3 and MCICV10-A3 are unrelated, and pairing them let a real repair vouch for an untouched one. The checks accumulated so far - grep every clause that enumerates a set, grep the acceptance classes for a newly required artifact, diff each edited list for removals - would all pass here. The check that catches it is to take each id named in an honestyRepairs entry, open the frozen verdict it belongs to, read the locations that finding cites, and confirm those specific paths moved. Run against v11 that yields exactly V11-S1, and it is cheap because every frozen verdict is already pinned by digest in appliesFindingsOf.

All four claimed repairs are real and verified against the subject's bytes and against the live D-002 entry, and every predecessor verdict record is certified directly against frozen bytes. The surviving finding is a succession-record defect whose underlying substance both this reviewer and the frozen Codex verdict assess as advisory-grade with no qualification escape.
verdictStatement: v11 is the cleanest candidate in this chain. The named-property list is restored at full width - five properties including the authoritative-closure deferral v10 dropped, plus the TypeScript-only role this reviewer recommended adding - and the LIVE block now re-verifies four of them, each of which this reviewer independently confirmed against the live coordinator bytes. Both live locators name only the block whose standing is LIVE, with no generation parenthetical and correct spelling, so the recurrence predicted for this cycle did not happen. DEF-WIN is explicitly a deferred-slot sentinel outside validatedPlatformSets, and the predecessor records gained a qualifiedIds field that settles a labelling drift open since v5. The roster is closed at zero off-roster paths, the substantive contract is byte-identical, and the re-measurement was taken at the adopted head so there is no drift to excuse - notable because this dispatch, unlike the four before it, grants no PASS-NO-SCOPE-EFFECT allowance and none was needed. One finding survives, and it is in the ledger rather than the contract. honestyRepairsFromV10 marks Codex's MCICV10-A3 repaired in an entry that describes this reviewer's unrelated CLAUDE-V10-A3; the four clauses Codex's finding cites are byte-identical, and notFolded does not book it. The unrepaired substance - one disposition label serving both cells G16-14 calls non-members and ROLELESS-NA cells that members makes members, plus a language-gate group attributed wholly to DR-118 against gateRides' three distinct rides - is advisory-grade and produces no escape. What is not advisory-grade is a real repair standing surety for an untouched one. DR-121 remains OPEN; DR-G16 remains PROPOSED, not QUALIFIED; no DR is marked SATISFIED.
authorityOfThisVerdict: This verdict is a reviewer opinion recorded for coordinator disposition. It applies nothing, edits no subject, marks no DR SATISFIED, marks no gate QUALIFIED, authorizes no implementation, chooses no CI vendor, mints no D-096 (A) grant, and does not touch docs/v2/architecture/08-decision-and-readiness-register.md or docs/coop/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md. It did not edit the review prompt it was given.
coordinatorNote: V11-S1 admits a one-line resolution in either direction and the coordinator should pick which. Booking MCICV10-A3 in notFoldedThisSuccessor needs no roster change and is honest. Folding it needs /componentLane and /g16Tests/corpus/fixtureDomainBasis/rolelessNaQualification added to the v12 roster, and Codex's own suggested fix is precise: call ROLELESS-NA cells language-gate N/A rather than out-of-preview-domain, point the exemption at componentLane.must[7] specifically, preserve must[0..6] and signed closure evidence explicitly, and keep the three distinct DR-118/DR-119/DR-120 rides. Either way the entry should be split so a repair credited to one reviewer's finding no longer vouches for another's. Two process notes. First, the frozen-predecessor-readable convention has now paid off in seven consecutive cycles and is the only reason V11-S1 is visible - the entry reads as accurate unless the frozen Codex verdict is opened and its cited locations checked. Second, if the coordinator wants a mechanical gate before the next dispatch, the id-to-locations check described in the systemic observation is the one this cycle would have needed, and every input it requires is already pinned by digest inside appliesFindingsOf.
